headline: Median MP is 52; Malaysia's median age is 31. A PM term limit fell two votes short.
context: Malaysian MPs have a median age of 52.4; the population, 31.3. Only 11 of 222 MPs are aged 35 or under. On 2 March 2026 a 10-year PM term limit won 146 votes, two short of the 148 needed.

changes.summary: Correction: Earlier editions attributed a PAS Youth call for a prime minister under 70 to PAS president Hadi Awang; it is removed, along with career-length figures and figures on Indonesian, women and Orang Asli MPs that we could not confirm, including in the closing view. France's 2024 change of prime minister is now stated exactly.

Correction: the 10-year term-limit bill fell two votes short on 2 March 2026 (146 for, 148 needed), not 3 March, and was not voted down; Malaysia's median age is now cited from official statistics (31.3 for the whole population), and unconfirmed claims that half of voters are under 40 and that no MP aged 30 or younger is a woman are removed.

Correction: we now give the period IDEAS counted (to October 2025), date the 2019 candidacy-age change without implying when it took effect, describe the gratuity and pension figures as an MP reported them, and say MPs, not voters, cast the 2019 and 2026 votes.

cards.big: The median Malaysian MP is 52; Malaysia's median age, 31. Only 5% of MPs are 35 or younger, and the constitution does not stand in the way.
cards.sub: On 2 March 2026 a bill capping a PM at 10 years won 146 votes, two short of the 148 needed. Another 44 MPs abstained and 32 were absent.

cards.big: Same cast since the 1970s. Lim Kit Siang won his first seat in 1969 and retired only in 2022. Anwar, who founded ABIM in 1971, became PM at 75.
cards.sub: Hadi Awang was returned unopposed as PAS president in Sept 2025. Mahathir was still contesting at GE15, and lost Langkawi and his deposit.

cards.big: Ministers may qualify for gratuities reported up to RM2 million. Stacked pensions across MP, ADUN, and cabinet roles can exceed RM100,000 a month.
cards.sub: IDEAS counted 238 political appointments to government boards under the current government, Nov 2022 to Oct 2025. PN era: 53 in 17 months; PH: 25 in 22.

cards.big: France's 34-year-old PM in 2024 was replaced eight months later by Michel Barnier, 73. Anwar's Dec 2025 'reset' made the Speaker's son Youth and Sports Minister at 29.
The candidacy age was cut to 18 in 2019. In March 2026 a 10-year PM term limit fell two votes short. The machinery refuses to constrain itself.
Imagine a relay race that pays each runner more the longer they hold the baton, and the baton tends to pass to the runner's son.
cards.sub: Up to RM2 million gratuity on leaving the cabinet. Stacked pensions that can top RM100,000 a month.

cards.big: The bottleneck is not age. It is the machinery that picks candidates, rewards long tenure and leaves just 11 of 222 MPs aged 35 or under.
cards.sub: MPs voted for renewal twice: unanimously in 2019, two votes short in March 2026. The question at GE16: who names the machinery and runs against it?
